health_desc: Live health snapshot: success rate / avg time / breaker state / health score per sub-source
health_footnote:
Status legend (grouped by whether the source can serve playback):
• In use: a real playback request within the last 10 min; sorted first.
• Healthy: enabled with samples, breaker closed; eligible for racing.
• Awaiting sample: enabled but no success/failure/probe sample yet — unknown, not broken. Turns healthy/abnormal after the next request or probe.
• Sleeping: probe failed 3 rounds; probing paused and retried every 10 rounds. Wakes automatically.
• Disabled: turned off manually or auto-disabled after probe failures; not raced or probed. Manual off stays off.
• Removed: real playback failed 3 times; taken out of the race chain. A half-open probe runs about 5 minutes later (default, adjustable in Config) and revives on success.
• Breaker open: a source+quality tier hit the failure threshold; cooling down. Moves to half-open after cooldown.
• Half-open: trial state after cooldown, one request allowed. Success closes, failure reopens.
• Abnormal: breaker closed but 0% success and score <0; looks healthy while upstream is dead.
• Throttling: in a 429 backoff window; not raced until backoff ends.
• Rate-limited: repeated 429s; heavier than throttling.
Health score: ≥3 green, ≥−5 default, <−5 red; success rate <60% red.
Key differences: awaiting sample ≠ disabled (no evidence vs deliberately off); sleeping ≠ removed (probe layer vs playback layer); breaker open ≠ removed (source+tier vs whole source). "-" means no sample; refresh every 30s. Tap the state chip to enable/disable.
Summary uses 9 buckets: healthy/abnormal/breaker open/half-open/awaiting sample/sleeping/disabled/removed/throttling; their sum equals the source count.
health_no_source: No source supports health query (requires health action, v4.0+)

health_cfg_desc_cacheTtlMs: How long a successful low-quality URL is cached; hits skip upstream requests.
health_cfg_desc_cacheTtlHighQualityMs: Cache TTL for successful flac/320k URLs; signed URLs are short-lived, so keep it short.
health_cfg_desc_failCacheNotFoundMs: After a song is confirmed missing/no-copyright, how long to skip repeat requests.
health_cfg_desc_failCacheExpiredMs: Short failure cache for expired signatures and 410 dead links.
health_cfg_desc_breakerThreshold: Consecutive failures before a source's breaker opens.
health_cfg_desc_breakerCooldownMs: Cooldown after the breaker opens, then one half-open probe is allowed.
health_cfg_desc_maxConcurrency: Requests a single source may run at once; too high triggers upstream risk control.
health_cfg_desc_rateWindowMs: Length of the sliding rate-limit window.
health_cfg_desc_rateWindowMax: Maximum requests allowed in one rate-limit window.
health_cfg_desc_raceBudgetMs: Total URL-fetch budget shared across quality tiers for one song request.
health_cfg_desc_raceBudgetFloorMs: Budget reserved for the last tier so high quality cannot starve playback.
health_cfg_desc_raceBatchSize: Number of sources probed concurrently in each race batch.
health_cfg_desc_raceBatchStaggerMs: Stagger between batches to reduce burst concurrency.
health_cfg_desc_raceMatchWaitMs: Wait window for an in-flight verified source's result.
health_cfg_desc_coldStartTimeoutMs: Timeout for a cold-start source to fetch one URL.
health_cfg_desc_coldStartProbeTimeoutMs: Health probe timeout for cold-start sources; cold wake-up takes longer.
health_cfg_desc_qualityShortCircuitSampl: Consecutive failed samples before a source/tier is short-circuited.
health_cfg_desc_qualityShortCircuitProbe: How long a short-circuited tier waits before one probe is allowed again.
health_cfg_desc_verifyTimeoutMs: Network timeout for the 1KB delivery verification.
health_cfg_desc_verifyMinOriginalSec: Original duration below this value is not ratio-checked, avoiding false positives on short songs.
health_cfg_desc_verifyDurRatio: Real duration below this ratio of the original is treated as a preview fragment; 0 disables the ratio check.
health_cfg_desc_verifyDurGapSec: Real duration differs from the original by more than this many seconds before it is treated as a fragment; 0 disables the gap check.
health_cfg_desc_allFailShortTtlMs: Short cache after all-chain network failures, preventing repeated useless retries.
health_cfg_desc_playDeadReviveMs: After playback failures remove a source, how long before a half-open revive probe.
health_cfg_desc_memoryMapMax: Max entries kept in the per-song memory map, preventing long-run memory growth.
health_cfg_desc_verifyDelivery: Reads 1KB before delivery to check audio shape and duration; off means deliver without verification.
health_cfg_desc_truthfulQuality: Fills the quality label from the actually delivered quality, so requesting flac but getting 128K is shown as 128K.
health_cfg_desc_qualityFloor: Whether to fall back to 128K when high quality fails, avoiding silent playback.
health_cfg_desc_verifyOnCacheHit: Whether cached URLs are verified again, so dead links/fragments cannot bypass the gate.
health_cfg_desc_previewUrlPreFilter: Drops obvious preview/sample URLs by keyword before fetching.
health_cfg_desc_fragmentFallback: Whether to deliver a fragment marked as preview when all sources only have fragments.
health_cfg_desc_qualityShortCircuit: Whether a source/tier with long zero success is skipped to save budget.
health_cfg_desc_coldStartWarmEnabled: Whether to warm cold-start sources at startup, reducing first-fetch failures.
health_cfg_desc_crossPlatformEnabled: Whether to search other platforms for a strict match when the primary platform has no original, a mismatched song, or times out.
health_export_hint: Saved locally and shared manually. Never uploaded.
health_diag_truncated: Read limit reached; conclusions may be incomplete

health_diag_unweighted: {n} successes are pre-upgrade unweighted samples; rate is for reference only
health_decline_hint: Success rate dropped across the last 4 probes; watch it or switch source manually
health_advanced_warning: Turning off verification or fragment fallback changes delivery policy; only change for troubleshooting.
